_note: Prototype data. Every title is fictional; posters/backdrops are generated locally by tools/mock_art.

items.title: Neon Tide
items.overview: When the floating city of Meridian starts sinking one district at a time, a disgraced harbor engineer has six days to find out who rewired the tides.

art.poster: cinematic sci-fi thriller poster, a lone engineer in a yellow raincoat standing on a flooded neon-lit street of a floating futuristic city at night, magenta and cyan reflections in the water
art.backdrop: wide cinematic shot of a futuristic floating city at night half-sunk into a glowing ocean, magenta and cyan neon reflections, rain, moody atmosphere

items.title: The Last Lighthouse
items.overview: A keeper on a remote island receives letters from a ship that sank forty years ago.

art.poster: moody drama poster, a weathered lighthouse on a rocky island under a stormy teal sky, a single warm light in the window, an old ghostly ship faintly visible in the fog

items.title: Iron Orchard
items.overview: Farmers in a dust-choked future defend the last fruit trees on Earth from a mechanized harvesting army.

art.poster: epic action poster, a woman farmer holding a pitchfork standing in front of a glowing orchard while giant rusted harvesting robots loom on a dusty orange horizon
art.backdrop: wide epic shot of an orchard of glowing trees in a dusty orange desert with giant rusted robots on the horizon at sunset

items.title: Paper Moons
items.overview: Two rival stationery-shop owners on the same street fall for each other through anonymous origami notes.

art.poster: warm romantic comedy poster, a cozy city street at dusk with two small paper shops facing each other, hundreds of paper origami cranes and paper moons floating in the purple sky

items.title: Velocity Ghost
items.overview: An underground racer who has never been photographed is framed for a heist she didn't pull.

art.poster: high octane action poster, a sleek black sports car drifting through a tunnel with streaks of orange and blue light trails, motion blur, a woman driver silhouette

items.title: The Midnight Cartographer
items.overview: A young mapmaker discovers that every map she draws after midnight comes true.

art.poster: whimsical fantasy adventure poster, a girl with a lantern standing on a giant unrolled glowing map that turns into real mountains rivers and a starry night sky

items.title: Static Bloom
items.overview: A late-night radio host starts receiving calls from listeners who say the flowers are talking.

art.poster: unsettling horror poster, an old radio studio microphone overgrown with dark glowing purple flowers, static noise, deep shadows, a single red on-air light

items.title: Captain Pancake
items.overview: A breakfast-loving superhero must save Syrup City from the dreaded Waffle Iron.

art.poster: colorful 3D animated family movie poster, a heroic stack of pancakes wearing a red cape flying over a cartoon city made of breakfast food, bright sunny sky

items.title: Hollow Crown Valley
items.overview: A retired marshal returns to the mining town he once saved, now owned by the man he spared.

art.poster: classic western poster, a lone gunslinger on horseback silhouetted against a huge orange sunset over a desert valley with an old mining town

items.title: Signal Lost
items.overview: The crew of a deep-space relay station realize the distress call they've been answering is their own.

art.poster: tense space sci-fi poster, an astronaut floating outside a lonely space station with a giant blue and violet nebula behind, a glowing radio dish
art.backdrop: wide cinematic shot of a lonely space relay station orbiting in front of a huge blue and violet nebula, stars, a beam of signal light

items.title: The Quiet Heist
items.overview: A crew of retired librarians plans to rob the most secure archive in Europe without making a sound.

art.poster: stylish heist movie poster, five elderly people in elegant clothes standing in a grand dark library vault with tall bookshelves and a spotlight, teal and gold color grading

items.title: Summer of the Comet
items.overview: Four friends spend the last summer before college building a telescope to see a once-in-a-lifetime comet.

art.poster: nostalgic coming of age poster, four teenagers on bicycles on a hill at twilight looking up at a bright comet streaking across a purple and orange sky

items.title: Outpost Abyss
items.overview: Life, politics and murder aboard the deepest underwater research station ever built.

art.poster: dramatic TV series poster, a glowing underwater research station deep in a dark blue ocean trench, bioluminescent creatures, a diver in the foreground
art.backdrop: wide cinematic shot of a glowing underwater research station in a dark ocean trench with bioluminescent jellyfish

items.title: Back Alley Bistro
items.overview: A chaotic family restaurant tucked behind a laundromat tries to earn its first star.

art.poster: fun sitcom poster, a messy small restaurant kitchen in a back alley with string lights, a frazzled chef holding a flaming pan, warm colors

items.title: The Ashfall Chronicles
items.overview: Exiled heirs of a volcanic kingdom fight to reclaim a throne buried under ash.

art.poster: epic fantasy TV series poster, a warrior queen in dark armor standing before an erupting volcano with a ruined castle, ash falling like snow, orange and purple sky

items.title: Night Shift Detectives
items.overview: Two mismatched detectives only work cases that happen between midnight and dawn.

art.poster: noir crime TV poster, two detectives in long coats under a streetlight on a rainy city street at night, blue and magenta neon signs

items.title: Pixel & Pals
items.overview: A tiny robot and her video-game friends escape the arcade every night to explore the world.

art.poster: cute 3D animated kids TV poster, a small round friendly robot with big eyes and colorful pixel-art creature friends jumping out of a glowing arcade machine

items.title: Frontier Medics
items.overview: The only clinic for 400 miles, staffed by doctors who each have a reason to hide out there.

art.poster: rugged medical drama TV poster, a small clinic with a red cross on a snowy mountain frontier road, a medical helicopter overhead, golden hour
